scope: Independent adjudication of the current Prism findings against unchanged final source; not independent authorship review or commit admission for every staged path.

dispositions.reason: Press true is recognition/consumption, not a promise that state changed: saturated entry and a repeated decimal already return true without mutation. Error-state ASCII operator/delete keys intentionally leave Error visible; numeric/decimal entry and AC/Escape reset through the earlier branches. Both production button callbacks and command Execute invoke Press without using its boolean as a changed-state result. Returning true for consumed no-ops is coherent and the report identifies no violated recovery promise.
evidence: calculator/model.go:160-168: reset clears failure, expression, parts and fresh/result flags
calculator/commands.go:Execute calls Press and returns nil
calculator/view.go:key Activate calls Press; no state-change interpretation of bool

dispositions.reason: The only production assignment fresh=true follows append(parts, entry, key), establishing an even parts length of at least2. reset, successful equals, deletion that removes a pair, percent/sign, and fresh numeric entry clear fresh. UseHistory calls reset before setting result. Any path clearing parts because result is true is reached with fresh=false: result=true is established only by successful equals or UseHistory, both after fresh is cleared. Failure paths preserve existing parts or reset before new entry. Private fields cannot be independently changed through the public consumer API; the report explicitly concedes current paths are safe and supplies only a hypothetical future invalid assignment.
evidence: calculator/model.go:227-228: sole fresh=true after pair append
calculator/model.go:231-258: sign/percent clear fresh without removing parts
calculator/model.go:260-270: pair deletion immediately clears fresh
calculator/model.go:300-302 and UseHistory: parts clearing/result admission preserves invariant

dispositions.reason: Style.Validate explicitly rejects a set TextAlign outside Start/Center/End. Overlay carries TextAlign, and ResolveStyle invokes s.Validate after theme/kind/legacy/node resolution, rejecting any invalid value that survives the overlay. Theme.Validate independently checks both raw theme styles and resolved default/kind styles. AlignStretch is not an offered ui.Alignment constant; Align/Justify already use the same three-value admission. A proposed additional test is not evidence of a missing validation path or a current defect.
evidence: ui/app_style_test.go:valid resolved TextAlign override and invalid enum validation

dispositions.reason: Update flushes committed body changes before comparing the proposed note. titleChanged already calls BodyChanged before recording a title whenever the independent body is not composing. During body preedit, an earlier committed title remains admissible by design, while destructive/history actions refuse active composition. In the supported native adapter, committed model Apply/CommitComposition and committedEditorChange run in the same owner processing path; a subsequent native preview cannot interleave before that committed Change callback. The report supplies no concrete supported sequence that reverses the committed history. Skipping body admission for live preedit avoids recording uncommitted text or discarding an earlier title.
evidence: notes/model.go:428-456: explicit title admission and noncomposing BodyChanged
notes/model.go:ready/flush/Request: composition refusal and ordered settlement
drivers/cogent/editor.go:applyNativeText transaction updates model then immediately calls committedEditorChange on committed text change
